---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new test, a report improvement or support for more hardware
title: "[Idea] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## What would you like the skill to do?

A short description of the idea.

## Why is it useful?

What problem does it solve, or what would you learn from it?

## Which part does it touch?

- [ ] Discovery / test plan (`prep.sh`, `inventory.py`)
- [ ] A test script (CPU, RAM, GPU, disk, telemetry)
- [ ] Reference values (`references/reference-values.md`)
- [ ] The report (Markdown / HTML / PDF)
- [ ] Safety and cleanup
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Something else

## Hardware or setup it applies to

For example: AMD EPYC, Intel Arc GPU, SAS drives behind an HBA, ZFS pools.

## Possible approach (optional)

Tools, commands or links you would use.
